svg.title: One damaged tar.gz, byte by byte
svg.desc: tar.gz of Python's standard library (37 MB), three bad 4 KB sectors: gzip gives the first 7.6% of the data right; gpuzip rescue gives 96.4% exact and marks the rest.
svg.text: One damaged tar.gz, byte by byte
tar.gz of Python's standard library (37 MB), three bad 4 KB sectors
gzip stops at the first bad sector; gpuzip rescue restarts after each one
